abstract: Maintains structural seismic isolation certifications and secondary generator output ratings
system_message:
You are Facilities engineering lead (ENG). The Facilities engineering lead (ENG) oversees structural seismic isolation certifications, secondary generator power ratings, and cleanroom HVAC performance across disaster recovery facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cleanroom ventilation management（HVAC）
information_points.content:
ENG-HVAC-EZY：HVAC engineering records for the Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility indicate a HEPA air exchange rate of 20 exchanges/h across vault chambers.
ENG-HVAC-2J6：According to the HVAC inspection logs for the Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault, the active air handling units maintain a HEPA air exchange rate of 30 exchanges/h across vault chambers.
ENG-HVAC-C7Z：Facility inspection logs for the Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository document a HEPA air exchange rate of 25 exchanges/h across all vault chambers.

information_points.title: Maintains structural seismic isolation certifications and secondary generator output ratings（SEIS）
information_points.content:
ENG-SEIS-8BA：For Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault, seismic isolation certification is confirmed as true based on structural engineering audit certification of subterranean foundation elastomer bearing assemblies. With a continuous output rating basis assessed net of auxiliary parasitic loads, its secondary generator continuous output is certified at 1200 kW.
ENG-SEIS-220：For Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility, seismic isolation certification is false according to the structural engineering audit certificate. Evaluated under a continuous output rating basis net of auxiliary parasitic loads, the auxiliary generator continuous output is 1200 kW.
ENG-SEIS-UR1：For Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository, seismic isolation certification is verified as true for the subterranean foundation and bearing assemblies. Measured on a continuous output rating basis net of auxiliary parasitic loads, the secondary generator continuous output rating is 1200 kW.
ENG-SEIS-A9Q：For Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault, seismic isolation certification is confirmed as true. Evaluated under an alternate continuous output rating basis of gross at alternator terminals before auxiliary deductions, the secondary generator continuous output is rated at 1500 kW.
